notes.title: Demo Hotfix | Patch Notes 1
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where buildings would not construct properly unless they were selected.

Resolved a bug that prevented Dark Matter from being collected under certain conditions.

Fixed a bug that blocked shields and turrets from being deployed.

Please restart your game to apply the update. Let us know if you encounter any other issues!

notes.title: Astra Sentinel - Playtest Coming Soon!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the Astra Sentinel playtest will be opening soon! 🚀 You can now request access, and Steam will notify you when the test goes live. The Playtest will be open to all participants.

This playtest is an opportunity to evaluate the game's technical aspects and performance. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the future of the game!

Please note:

 This is a technical test, so expect some bugs and unfinished features.
 Content is limited at this stage, as the focus is on testing performance and stability.

Thank you to all players who join the test, we truly appreciate your support! 🙌

Happy gaming,
Somnambulist Games team.
